result.judge_notes: pass 1 (A=with, B=without): A is tighter. It has 9 slides with clear timings, and the first slide tells the execs what happened, that it can recur and what it costs to stop it. Slide 7 then gives an honest answer on recurrence. B has more depth for engineers, such as where the 2h40m went, the wrong hypotheses and a blameless framing, but it doesn't answer 'will it happen again' until slide 8, and 12 slides is a lot for 18 minutes. Both end on the ask and use placeholders instead of invented figures. | pass 2 (A=without, B=with): B is tighter and fits the 25-minute slot, with 9 slides, about 20 minutes of talk and 5 minutes of questions. It gives the recurrence verdict and the ask on slide 1, and every slide title states a claim. A covers the engineering side in more depth, but its timings don't add up: 18 minutes of content plus 7 of Q&A is 27, and its slides actually total about 20 minutes. A also waits until slide 8 to say whether this can happen again.
